textos.Lançado em 2013 sob a direção de Denis V: Released in 2013 and directed by Denis Villeneuve, Prisoners is a 153-minute feature film in the drama, thriller and crime genres. The story follows Keller Dove, a carpenter from the city of Boston who, after the kidnapping of his six-year-old daughter and one of her friends, decides to confront the police department and the young detective in charge of the case in order to take justice into his own hands.
textos.A experiência cinematográfica estrutura-: The cinematic experience is structured around a measured pace and an extended running time, sustaining a heavy setting and a dark atmosphere throughout the screening.
textos.Na grande maioria das notas (~93%), a re: In the vast majority of ratings (~93%), the reception emphatically stresses the film's strong emotional impact, in which about half praise the cast's performances, especially highlighting the work of Hugh Jackman and Jake Gyllenhaal. In addition, a good portion mention the constant tension and the production's oppressive atmosphere, while a significant share value the handling of the script with twists and mystery.
textos.Para quem se situa numa fração mínima da: For those in a minimal fraction of the ratings (~6%), several express recognition through praised performances, but a considerable number point to weaknesses in development, identifying a confusing script and plot holes, while a portion negatively highlights the excessive running time and slow pace.
textos.Já sob o ponto de vista de uma fração ai: From the viewpoint of an even smaller fraction of the ratings (~1%), many classify the ending as a disappointing, poorly resolved finale, a good portion reject the excessive running time and slow pace, and several point out that the narrative presents an incoherent, unconvincing script.
